items.label: ERGONOMIC BACK SUPPORT FOR LONG SITTING
items.value: Our 3D inflatable lumbar pillow gently supports your lower, mid, or upper back. Balanced pressure distribution helps reduce discomfort and encourages natural S-curve alignment for better posture during long flights, commuting, or desk work.

items.label: TRAVEL LUMBAR PILLOW FOR AIRPLANE & OFFICE
items.value: Ideal as an airplane lumbar support pillow for long flights and business trips, and also as lumbar support for office chair, car seat, or train commute. Reliable support wherever you sit—travel, home, or work.

items.label: QUICK INFLATE/DEFLATE, ADJUSTABLE FIRMNESS
items.value: Customize the feel in seconds—inflate for firm support or release air for a softer fit. This inflatable lumbar pillow lets you dial in comfort for each seat and each trip.

items.label: ADJUSTABLE STRAP THAT STAYS PUT
items.value: The adjustable band secures the pillow to an airplane seat, office chair, or car seat to reduce slipping. Get consistent travel lumbar support during flights and long sitting—without constant readjustment.

items.label: ULTRA-COMPACT AIRPLANE BACK PILLOW FOR TRAVEL
items.value: Weighing just 5.64 oz, it deflates to 3.5" × 6.3" and packs easily into carry-ons or backpacks. Best comfort at 60–70% air (approx. 13.8" × 7.9" × 3.7")—perfect for long flights and on-the-go support.

items.label: PREMIUM, SKIN-FRIENDLY MATERIALS
items.value: Made with high-quality, leak-resistant, waterproof, breathable materials for a comfortable feel and dependable performance—indoors or outdoors.

items.label: EASY CARE & HYGIENIC DESIGN
items.value: The pillow's cover is designed to be easily removed for convenient washing, ensuring your pillow stays clean and fresh for every journey, whether at home, office, or as a travel lumbar pillow for airplane travel.
